findings.title: Harness stdout is forwarded to the third-party TypeSafe endpoint, contradicting the documented no-repository-content guarantee
findings.evidence: Probe: a claude-code is_error stdout whose `result` quotes a repository secret (sk-live-...) is forwarded verbatim to judgment.choice state.error_text. Same on the generic _short_output path (line 925). .env.example:151 claims 'never repository content or agent transcripts'.

findings.title: Placeholder ranking can discard the agent's real answer when a quoted example scores equal
findings.evidence: Probe exact tie: REAL (payload-only angle-bracket fields) scores 2, EXAMPLE scores 2; when the real answer comes first the example is selected. Pre-existing on main, only partially fixed by this branch.

findings.title: Engine test suite is unrunnable on the host's default Python 3.14; only a 3.12 venv works
findings.evidence: python3 is 3.14; venv built on /root/.local/bin/python3.12 was required to run the suite at all.

findings.title: worker.py is not ruff-formatted, breaking an engine lint gate that is a hard CI gate
findings.evidence: ruff format --check . => 'File would be reformatted' for worker.py; main passes with '50 files already formatted'.
